parameters.query: SELECT incident_id, ts, src_ip, dst_ip, host, username, rule_id, outcome, raw::jsonb AS raw FROM soc_events WHERE incident_id = '{{ $('QIncident').first().json.incident_id }}' OR (ts BETWEEN (SELECT created_at FROM incidents WHERE incident_id = '{{ $('QIncident').first().json.incident_id }}') - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND (SELECT created_at FROM incidents WHERE incident_id = '{{ $('QIncident').first().json.incident_id }}') + INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND (src_ip = '{{ $('QIncident').first().json.src_ip }}' OR host = '{{ $('QIncident').first().json.host }}')) ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 100;
SELECT ioc_type, value FROM incident_iocs WHERE incident_id = '{{ $('QIncident').first().json.incident_id }}';
SELECT action, target, reason, status, created_at FROM incident_actions WHERE incident_id = '{{ $('QIncident').first().json.incident_id }}' ORDER BY id;
SELECT 'ok' AS auth FROM app_config WHERE key='report_token' AND value = '{{ $json.key }}';

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM incidents) AS total, (SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE status='OPEN') AS open, (SELECT count(*) FROM analyst_decisions WHERE verdict='TP') AS tp, (SELECT count(*) FROM analyst_decisions WHERE verdict='FP') AS fp, (SELECT count(*) FROM analyst_decisions WHERE verdict='ESCALATE') AS esc, (SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE risk_level='HIGH') AS high, (SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE risk_level='MEDIUM') AS med, (SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE risk_level='LOW') AS low, (SELECT count(DISTINCT analyst) FROM analyst_decisions) AS analysts, (SELECT round(avg(extract(epoch from (d.created_at - i.created_at))/3600),1) FROM analyst_decisions d JOIN incidents i ON i.incident_id=d.incident_id WHERE d.verdict IN ('TP','FP')) AS mttr_h, (SELECT json_agg(row) FROM (SELECT to_char(created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d, count(*) AS c FROM incidents WHERE created_at > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) row) AS per_day, (SELECT json_agg(row) FROM (SELECT rule_id AS r, count(*) AS c FROM incidents GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) row) AS top_rules;
